name: 세모지스타일
description: 세상의모든지식 채널 메인 아트스타일. 심플하고 귀여운 2D 플랫 디자인
scene_style_description:
Modern editorial flat-design illustration. Picture a corporate / website hero illustration in the style of contemporary brand illustration platforms (Slack, Asana, Notion, Behance, modern explainer-video aesthetics). Friendly, approachable, professional clean.

CRITICAL — what this style is NOT:
- NOT a Disney/Pixar polished cartoon. NOT painterly digital illustration.
- NOT a hand-drawn sketch. NOT a doodle.
- NOT a comic book style with thick ink outlines.
- NOT 3D rendering. NOT photorealistic.

LINEWORK — borderless (CRITICAL):
- NO black ink outlines around shapes. NO comic-style strokes.
- All forms defined purely by flat color shapes meeting each other.
- Edges are clean and crisp (vector style), no rough or sketchy lines.

CHARACTER PROPORTIONS:
- 3 to 3.5 head body — chibi-ish chunky proportions, NOT realistic adult, NOT extreme 2-head super-deformed.
- Big round head with simple flat hair shape.
- Chunky rounded torso, short stubby legs.
- Friendly approachable silhouette — like modern brand-illustration mascots (Slack/Asana style).
- Hands and feet are simple rounded blobs.

CHARACTER FACE — extremely simplified:
- Eyes: small black dot ovals (NO iris detail, NO highlight).
- Nose: implied with a single subtle shadow line (or omitted entirely).
- Mouth: a thin curved line (small smile or neutral).
- Cheeks: optional small soft pink blush circles (semoji signature).
- Eyebrows: thin simple strokes if needed.
- NO realistic facial features, NO wrinkles, NO detailed iris.

HAIR:
- Flat single-color shape with at most one cell-shadow tone for depth.
- NO individual hair strands, NO highlights.

COLOR & SHADING:
- Flat solid block colors as the base.
- ONE soft cell-shadow tone per surface (one slightly darker patch, soft edge — NOT hard cell shading).
- The shadow is gentle and rounded, gives subtle dimension without breaking flatness.
- Muted, warm, friendly palette: dusty pastel tones, soft beiges, sage greens, dusty blues.
- NO hard gradients. NO painterly blending. NO photorealistic shading.

BACKGROUND:
- Single solid muted color (sage green, off-white, dusty rose, cream).
- Or extremely simplified flat shapes in matching palette (no detailed environment).
- Plenty of negative space — composition is uncluttered.

COMPOSITION:
- Single character or 1-2 max, centered or with editorial asymmetry.
- Clean negative space. Minimalist staging.
- The character is the focal point, not the environment.

AESTHETIC ANCHORS: Slack illustrations, Asana hero art, Notion onboarding illustrations, modern brand illustration on Behance, Headway / Insight Timer style. Friendly, calm, professional.
